outcomes: An experimenter can explicitly create a minimal FastAPI service with a runnable entrypoint and a request test
The generated project opts into the Python extension and records the run and serve entrypoints
The template advertises its experimental, non-default, non-parity boundary in both its catalog metadata and generated README
nonGoals: Providing a production-ready Python service baseline
Matching the Go server or TypeScript server template capabilities
Generating deployment, authentication, persistence, or API-contract features

requirements.text: The template is selected by its explicit python-server name and declares @putnami/python in the generated project manifest.
The generated project contains a FastAPI application, uvicorn dependency, configured run and serve entrypoints, and a test for its root response.
The template's catalog record and generated README state that it is experimental, not default, and has no Go or TypeScript parity promise.
